lines: d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Arturo Rao is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ Arturo is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

d41: Stonebridge watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer. (Trust -8.
d41: 🕯️ Arturo Rao is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Arturo kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "Arturo's gone." Elif looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Arturo." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d41: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Sal blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Tracks (Level 1). Fresh tracks have sharp edges. Old tracks crumble. You can tell how recently something passed.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Patient Aim (Level 1). One shot. You don't take the shot unless it's the shot.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Weather (Level 1). Red sky at night, shepherd's delight. Red sky at morning, shepherd's warning. It works.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Animal Behavior (Level 1). Most animals flee. Give them an escape route and they take it. Cornered animals fight.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Wire Snares (Level 1). A loop of wire on a game trail. Simple, effective, ancient. Check at dawn.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Reading the Water (Level 1). You know where fish hold: seams, eddies, shade lines. The water stops being a surface and starts being a map.
d41: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Arturo Rao, 41 days. The mantle passes to Sal Guzman.
d41: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Sal Guzman, 54 — a fishing guide. Their hands know different work now: Beast-calm, Echo Location.
d41: The village's quarrel was with Arturo — and Arturo is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d41: At the grave, Jayden, Jian, Pamela and 5 more speak for Sal — "Arturo trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d41: The fire knew Sal before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
